Uranus and Pluto traded friendly glances.

Uranus made a friendly trine to Pluto early this morning. The Moon is in Leo all day and squares Mercury in Scorpio this afternoon. Swipe for Cancer, Scorpio and Pisces, plus one question to journal on today.

Save this for tonight, or send it to your Water friend. 🌙
